purpose: Normative machine-readable contract schema for every GlobusOS OS function. This schema defines required contract fields; it does not assert implementation or verification.

required_function_fields.id: Stable ATC-FUNC-OS-* identifier; immutable once published.
required_function_fields.owner_boundary: Exactly one canonical implementation owner; consumers are listed separately.
required_function_fields.priority: P0, P1, or P2 with rationale.
required_function_fields.inputs: Typed input schema, validation constraints, caller identity and trust assumptions.
required_function_fields.outputs: Typed successful result and externally observable state changes.
required_function_fields.preconditions: Required system state and authorization context.
required_function_fields.postconditions: Guaranteed state after success; no partial mutation on failure unless specified.
required_function_fields.invariants: Safety, determinism, isolation, lifecycle and resource invariants.
required_function_fields.errors: Stable error codes, conditions, recovery behavior, and side-effect guarantees.
required_function_fields.authorization: Required principal, capability, policy decision, approval and fail-closed behavior.
required_function_fields.concurrency: Synchronization, ordering, cancellation and race semantics.
required_function_fields.resource_limits: Memory, handles, queue, time/gas and exhaustion behavior as applicable.
required_function_fields.audit: Security events, provenance fields, redaction and retention requirements.
required_function_fields.interfaces: Versioned API/ABI/IPC/syscall/event contracts and compatibility rules.
required_function_fields.tests: Positive, negative, boundary, fault-injection and property tests.
required_function_fields.evidence: Exact source SHA, blob SHA, tests, CI run/job/step, E2E and audit evidence.
required_function_fields.source_binding: Exact symbol binding; null only while discovery is incomplete.
required_function_fields.status: Evidence-backed lifecycle status; never inferred from name/path/docs alone.
required_function_fields.traceability: COMPLETE only when every required traceability edge is present.
required_function_fields.residuals: Explicit unresolved contract, source, test, hardware, security or governance gaps.

rules: No function may be marked IMPLEMENTED, TESTED, CI-VERIFIED, E2E-VERIFIED, AUDITED or RELEASE-READY without matching evidence.
Unknown or unavailable sources require explicit residual/exclusion records; no silent omissions.
A UI screen or setting is not a backend function unless it has a defined authoritative API/service contract.
ShivaCore TCB owns only kernel-authoritative mechanisms; networking, AI, wallet, chain tooling and UI remain service/platform boundaries unless architecture governance explicitly decides otherwise.
Consensus, cryptographic protocol, authorization and state-transition ambiguities are BLOCKED, not guessed.
Source binding is keyed by repository, exact HEAD SHA, path, blob SHA, symbol kind and symbol name.
Catalog completeness and implementation verification are separate gates.
